title: Italian beef sandwiches
ingredients: Pepperoncini plus a splash of brine
steps: Season beef. Brown in a pot, then add onion, garlic, seasoning, broth, and pepperoncini.
Braise covered at 300°F until shreddable, 3–4 hours (or slow cooker on low 8 hours).
Shred meat into the juices. Pile on rolls with provolone and giardiniera. Dip in jus.
